component.title: Asset Detail Shell
component.purpose: Present an asset preview and metadata while independently reporting supporting activity lifecycle.

states.description: Supporting activity is loading while the asset and metadata remain available.
Asset detail and activity are usable.
The asset has no supporting activity.
Supporting activity is incomplete without blocking the asset task.
Supporting activity failed and can offer retry.

claims.statement: Supporting activity is rendered through AsyncPanel and exposes its lifecycle via ExperienceSurface.
Preview and metadata remain structurally available when only supporting activity is partial or failed.
